text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C for gains felt rewarding, but a realized gain alone does not show whether the overall portfolio decision was good; I should weigh each trade against my goals and the portfolio as a whole.","I later bought Stock B and Stock C back at lower prices, but a lower price or my old selling price is not by itself a reason to buy; I should consider each stock’s prospects and an appropriate allocation.","When my account fell for several periods, I made no trades and it later recovered somewhat. I should avoid reacting to short-term moves, but still review my plan periodically rather than letting reluctance to trade replace deliberate decisions."]}
